subject: mathematics
concept: Money as a real-world decimal application (dollars and cents)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student counts on-screen coins/bills to make a target amount
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a shopping receipt image to its written decimal total
exercise.abstract: Student adds and compares simple money amounts written as decimals

misconception_flags: confuses cents place with tenths place in non-money contexts

interest_binding: exercise generated using student's stated interest profile (e.g. buying items related to their interests)
